text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —*gasp... pant...*!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I can win, I will win, win...!
Run, don't break, go, go――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Stick to your guns, no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "‘Hold on to your pride until the end.’"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!
SHUT THE HELL UUUUPPPPP............!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
This year's Derby Umamusume is...
Air Shakur...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Shakuuur~~!!
Congraaaats~~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The board... in 1st place, that's my number.
There are people shouting my name...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So...
she really won, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...No freakin' way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It seriously changed.
Those 7 cm... were totally overturned.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Truly—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: She truly... changed destiny.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ……Aaaaargh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Hahah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No fukin' way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur slumped down to the ground as if all his strength had left him.
At this unprecedented action, the stands were enveloped
in a murmur quite unlike the usual cheering—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I pushed it through.
...My stubborn pride, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What a goofy face.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wipe that smirk off your face.
Idiot.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Of course I'm laughing. 'Cause we won..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I won. In the Derby, where I got
beaten to a pulp hundreds of times...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I won, didn't I?!
Come on, doesn't it just make ya laugh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it, this ain't a dream.
Everyone at the racetrack is a witness.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Seriously, ain't this crazy?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oops, this is no time to be laughing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Gotta report the results
to "Parcae"-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Depending on that, this victory might become entirely meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will winning the Derby change her fate beyond that point...?
She once told me that was the single most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what comes next is what really counts.
You'd better give me some good news—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy, Air Shakur sat facing the computer for a while.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae"...
threw an error on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...No, the other functions seem fine.
I'll run a check."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know the cause,
but errors have started popping up
only regarding win/loss results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In all the races ahead,
I couldn't see the placements anymore.
choice_data_list: Does that mean... destiny has changed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In truth, it's after the 7cm switch. Maybe we should go ahead and lock it in.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's waiting up ahead ain't hell.
It's a completely blank, brand-new unknown, that's what.
choice_data_list: Which means the Senior Class is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You're jumping the gun. Just because the outcome isn't clear doesn't mean the causes leading to that worst-case fate have vanished.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, let's put that topic aside for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "I might even totally bomb the Kikuka Sho that I was supposed to win next."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our next target is the final crown, the Kikuka Sho...
According to "Parcae," this victory would make Air Shakur a Double Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If a crushing defeat is possible,
then there's also the chance for a massive upside...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She might even win by a huge margin.
Well, can't say for sure, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Could it be... that Air Shakur is looking forward to the future for the very first time?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ah, come to think of it, summer camp's coming up real soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I had already decided on the training menu, but... I suppose I'll have "Parcae" reconstruct it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The other functions work fine.
Its processing power, its analytical capability...
It's all still totally usable. I ain't throwing it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: She is getting closer to reaching the conditions for winning her first Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If she exceeds that theoretical limit during summer camp,
we might see results beyond anything we expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —...It's no use.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I don't know what caused the error,
there's no way in hell I can fix it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, the mystery still remains.
Those numbers, "991031021222"...
Why did they appear, and why did they suddenly vanish?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae"...
What are you trying to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid? There's no way
something like that exists.
